program.help:
Convert a neurosuite/ndManager XML parameter file to the YAML format used by neurosuite-3.
All sections are preserved: generalInfo, acquisitionSystem, fieldPotentials, files, anatomicalDescription, spikeDetection, units, neuroscope (channel colors and offsets), and programs.
The original XML file is not modified. If no output path is given, the YAML file is written alongside the XML file with the same base name.
USAGE
ndm_xml2yaml SESSION.xml [OUTPUT.yaml]
NOTES
Supports both <n> and <name> tag variants produced by different ndManager versions. Parameter values are type-coerced to bool, int, or float where appropriate. Sentinel dash-strings used by ndManager to indicate empty unit fields ("--", "---", etc.) are mapped to null.
